definitions.explanation: The seat of government, especially historically.
A major urban center, especially one known for culture or sophistication.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}は{昔|むかし}の{都|みやこ}だった。

examples.notes: Poetic expression for a beautiful city

examples.japanese: {都|みやこ}を{離|はな}れて{田舎|いなか}に{住|す}む。
examples.english: To leave the city and live in the countryside.

notes:
A somewhat literary or classical word for capital city.

HISTORICAL CAPITALS OF JAPAN:
・{奈良|なら} (710-784)
・{京都|きょうと} (794-1868)
・{東京|とうきょう} (1868-present)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{花|はな}の{都|みやこ} (beautiful city, city of flowers)
・{古|ふる}の{都|みやこ}/{古都|こと} (ancient capital)
・{都|みやこ}{落|お}ち (fleeing the capital)

RELATED READINGS:
・{都|みやこ} - capital (native reading)
・{都|と} - metropolis (as in {東京都|とうきょうと})
・{首都|しゅと} - capital city (modern term)
